title: WPMS/2176/2009 of M/S MANISHA PHARMOPLAST P LTD Vs MAHESH MISHRA

paras.text:
CLMA No. 1664 of 2014
In
WPMS No. 2176 of 2009
Hon'ble B.S.Verma, J.
Mr. Pankaj Miglani, Advocate, present for the
petitioner.
Mr. P.C.Pethshali, Advocate, present for the
respondent.
This writ petition has been filed to set aside the
award dated 07.09.2009 passed by learned Labour
Court, Hardwar in Adjudication Case No. 278 of
2009.
The compromise application has been filed by
the parties which has been verified by the Registrar
Judicial.
The parties have arrived at compromise and
respondent-workman has accepted compensation ` 3
lakhs in lump sum in lieu of reinstatement and
service benefits.
In view of the compromise the respondent-workman has accepted compensation of ` 3 lakhs by
way of cheque in lieu of reinstatement in service and
other service benefits.
Impugned award dated 07.09.2009 is modified
in terms of the compromise. The writ petition stands
allowed. The compensation of 3 lakhs is awarded to
the respondent-workman in lieu of reinstatement in
service and other benefits.
(B. S. Verma, J. )
 05.03.2014
NP
